name: Canoas

queries.query: Canoas Brazil official cadastral parcel map GIS municipal geoprocessing property lots
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official GeoCanoas municipal ArcGIS REST catalog and public polygon services named Lotes_portal and Lote_GeoCanoas. The municipal procurement material also documents GeoCanoas as the city geoprocessing/SIG platform. No parcel geometry was assumed from search results alone.

queries.query: Canoas mapa cadastral lotes cadastro imobiliário geoprocessamento prefeitura GeoCanoas
queries.result: First-party/local-language discovery confirmed the Prefeitura de Canoas GeoCanoas public geoprocessing service and municipal cadastral terminology. Search also found official procurement text describing cadastro imobiliário and lot/quadra/sector coding, but that document is not an open parcel feature response.

registryCustodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Canoas; municipal GeoCanoas geoprocessing/SIG service

registryEvidence.observation: The official municipal host exposes public ArcGIS FeatureServer and MapServer services, including polygon layers named GISADMIN.lote_portal and GISADMIN.lote. This evidences a local municipal cadastral/geospatial service, not a land-registry title database.

sourceReview.crs: EPSG:31982 confirmed by layer metadata; outSR=4326 was requested only for a bounded test and did not return a successful feature response.
